world_org_meetings.title: World set to breach 1.5°C warming limit set by Paris Climate Agreement
world_org_meetings.description: The UN is warning that global commitments to cut planet-heating emissions are falling far short of the Paris climate goals of 1.5 degrees Celsius warming – and put the world on course for 2.6C warming this century. The report by the United Nations Environment Programme lays bare the chasm between rhetoric and action when it comes to tackling global warming, and the challenge before political leaders at November's COP31 climate summit - set to take place next month in Turkey. Story by Emerald Maxwell.

world_org_meetings.title: Search under way for four soldiers missing after gang attack in Haiti
world_org_meetings.description: The UN Security Council holds a meeting on Haiti; the attack on UN-backed forces is expected to dominate the discussions.

world_org_meetings.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelensky hails "real leaders" in Europe, blasts Trump's diesel deal with Russia
world_org_meetings.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. FRANCE 24's Europe Editor Armen Georgian reports from Brussels.

world_org_meetings.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

diplomatic_visits.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor on Trump's embrace of Russia
diplomatic_visits.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff visits Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

diplomatic_visits.title: Carney's Turkish balancing act must include business, defence and human rights
diplomatic_visits.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney heads to Turkey, seeking closer trade, energy and defence ties with a strategically important NATO ally. The historic visit marks a turnaround in relations once soured by a Canadian arms embargo. But Ankara’s crackdown on dissent tests Carney’s promise to balance economic pragmatism with Canadian values.

diplomatic_visits.title: Macron calls for extreme caution in Gulf, secures critical gas deal in Qatar state visit
diplomatic_visits.description: French president concludes his state visit by reinforcing the strategic partnership with Qatar. He declares his Gulf tour objectives achieved after securing a crucial gas deal with Qatar as he seeks to lower tensions over living costs in France.

diplomatic_visits.title: King Charles welcomes Oman’s Sultan Haitham for state visit to UK
diplomatic_visits.description: King Charles III and Queen Camilla, joined by Prince William and Princess Catherine, have welcomed Oman’s Sultan Haitham bin Tarik to Windsor at the start of a three-day state visit.

diplomatic_visits.title: Uzbekistan's $12bn business drive gathers pace during Rubio visit
diplomatic_visits.description: The package covers railways, critical minerals, finance and technology, with major US firms involved. Uzbek President Mirziyoyev outlined measures to attract investors, while business executives told Euronews that commercial activity is growing.

elections.title: Bulgaria: Concerns about security in the Black Sea dominate presidential election campaign
elections.description: Bulgaria's presidential election campaign has been shaped by recent drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea and the government's reduced support for Ukraine, making foreign policy a key factor in the first round.

elections.title: Meta's Zuckerberg pitches AI successes to investors with 26% rise in quarterly revenue
elections.description: Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg touted the company's progress on artificial intelligence during an earnings call on Wednesday and called for more investment. The tech giant's Muse AI agent has garnered 10 million users since its launch six weeks ago, while third-quarter revenue rose to $64.6 billion. Meanwhile, the company is accused of political interference in Brazil's presidential election. Also in this edition, we check in on France's rising borrowing costs.

elections.title: In Israel election, Palestinian citizens weigh fear against disillusionment
elections.description: With vote at knife’s edge, Palestinian citizens weigh principle against strategic voting in system stacked against them.

elections.title: Alberta's decisive decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump
elections.description: The overwhelming vote by Alberta to stay in Canada gives Mark Carney political capital to focus on remaking the country's economy, writes the BBC's Lyse Doucet.

elections.title: Cornell Jane Doe says embattled university head doubted her gang-rape allegation
elections.description: As a no-confidence vote looms, Cornell says the characterisation of the head's reaction is "incorrect".
